kappa_caveat: kappa is a nuisance parameter used only by across-seam constraints; the network structure cancels kappa against sheet translations, so when kappa_prior_dominated is true the value is the prior, not a measurement -- compare per-plate drafted street widths directly before reusing it downstream

manual_deviations.reason: D-019 chopped page numeral at the Ave C x 24th junction. Sheet 12 prints its own page number '12' with 'GALVESTON, TEXAS.' (glyph bbox canvas x 13681-13908, y 11529-11794) into the intersection; sheets 9, 10 and 11 map that ground as blank street. The cuts clipped it to a floating fragment. Deviating the 24th cut 100 px SOUTH (11713 -> 11813) over x 13849-13965 hands the fragment's pocket to sheet 10, which is measured fully blank there (0 ink px in x 13850-14000, y 11722-11960); west of the Ave C cut sheet 11 already suppresses the rest. The numeral is page furniture, suppressed whole by ownership - consistent with the D-013 precedent and with every other plate's page number, none of which appears mid-print. Sheet 9's date stamp (y 11923+) and page edge (x 13930+, west of Ave C irrelevant) stay clear of the deviation and its ramps.
manual_deviations.verified_by: controller (Fable), from four-plate junction warps and component bboxes
